recipe.visualDefinition: A multi-layered composition featuring a central group portrait of five men and one woman in 1980s formal and street fashion, set against a textured pastel pink and blue background with a prominent vertical sidebar and hand-painted graphic accents.
coreVisualRelationships: Central female figure acts as the focal point with male members flanking her symmetrically
Outer white border contains an inner teal-framed photographic field
Vertical black sidebar (obi) creates a strong left-side structural anchor
Hand-painted pink brushstroke behind the top title provides organic texture against rigid typography
coreInvariants: Pastel pink and teal color palette
Vertical sidebar layout on the left third

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Group is centered horizontally, occupying the middle 60% of the vertical space; female lead is slightly forward in scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The vertical black sidebar on the left provides the heaviest visual weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the top title, moves down through the group portrait, and is pulled left by the high-contrast vertical sidebar.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample white space in the outer border and top header area to balance the dense central imagery.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Off-white and pastel pink define the background and border areas.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black and navy in the clothing and sidebar provide structural depth.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Teal framing and magenta brushstrokes add vibrant 80s-specific highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value, low-saturation backgrounds contrast with high-saturation, low-value foreground subjects.
paletteRestrictions: Stick to muted pastels for backgrounds

letterConstructionRules: Primary title uses extreme vertical compression
characterSpecificRedesigns: Uniform stroke weight in the main title
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Condensed verticality paired with wide horizontal tracking.
graphicDevices: Teal inner border with soft drop shadow

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the ultra-condensed, high-impact feel of the main title
Provides the geometric, clean look for the wide-tracked subtitle

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a group portrait of six 1980s musicians in satin and leather outfits. Place them in a teal-bordered frame against a textured pink and blue studio backdrop. Surround the frame with a thick white border and a magenta stripe at the very top and bottom edges.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a black vertical sidebar on the left with white and grey text. Place a condensed black sans-serif title at the top center over a pink brushstroke, and a wide-tracked subtitle directly below it. Add a yellow circular sticker in the top right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the sidebar on the left side?
Is there a teal border around the photo?
Does the subtitle have wide letter spacing?

adjustableVariables: Number of people in the group
Specific pastel colors of the background
mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the original subjects

mustAchieve: Balanced use of negative space in the border
avoid: Grunge or distressed textures (except for the brushstroke)

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not overlap the subjects' faces
Verify the teal border is consistent on all four sides of the photo
Check that the vertical sidebar is solid black
Confirm the magenta brushstroke looks hand-painted
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a centered group portrait in a colored frame with a high-contrast vertical sidebar and ultra-condensed header typography over a textured paint element.
